description: This file defines the ExponentialBestFit class, which extends the BestFit class and implements exponential regression methods for trend analysis within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: ExponentialBestFit
classes.description: Implements exponential trend fitting methods, including regression and calculation of exponential equations.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y-value for a given X using the exponential model.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X-value for a specified Y using the exponential model.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns the exponential equation representing the best-fit curve.

methods.name: getSlope
methods.description: Returns the slope of the exponential model, optionally rounded to specified decimal places.

methods.name: getIntersect
methods.description: Returns the value of X where the exponential curve intersects Y=0.

methods.name: exponentialRegression
methods.description: Performs exponential regression using Y and X data points.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regression and computes the exponential fit.
